name: understudy
description: Learn any website's brand identity: measure color, typography, spacing, and motion from the live page, then synthesize its feel from the brand's own design writing.

interface.shortDescription: Measure a site's brand, then learn its feel
interface.longDescription: understudy drives a real browser to measure a website's whole brand identity - color palette with light/dark roles, typography, spacing and radius scales, and motion (durations, easings, springs, choreography) - and emits a design-model.yaml plus CSS/Tailwind/DTCG tokens. Then the agent learns the brand's feel from its own design writing and reconciles it against the measurement, under a never-quantize-a-vibe rule. The tool measures ground truth deterministically; the assistant adds the qualitative layer.
defaultPrompt: Extract the full brand identity of a website I give you
Measure this site's color, type, and motion tokens
Learn the feel of this brand and cite the sources
